children: Gossamer Bio announced a 1-for-80 reverse stock split and reduction of authorized common shares to 50,000,000 to help regain Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance.
Board selected a 1-for-80 reverse stock split effective Sept 10, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. ET; trading split-adjusted on Sept 11, 2026.
Authorized common shares reduced from 4,000,000,000 to 50,000,000; total authorized capital reduced to 120,000,000.
Every 80 shares pre-split will be combined into 1 share; fractional shares rounded up at record/DTC participant level.
Convertible notes, warrants, prefunded warrants and equity awards will be proportionately adjusted to reflect the 1-for-80 split.
